A Turlock Journal article (c. 2024) says the shelter lets the public take dogs out for free with no reservation, just paperwork, and overnights by special arrangement. The city site does not mention it, so it needs checking. Shelter at 801 S. Walnut Rd., open Mon-Sat 9:30am-5:30pm.
